scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @saferide/api" "npm run dev -w @saferide/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @saferide/shared && npm run build -w @saferide/api && npm run build -w @saferide/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @saferide/shared && npm run typecheck -w @saferide/api && npm run typecheck -w @saferide/web
scripts.verify:readiness: npm run build -w @saferide/shared && npm run build -w @saferide/api && node scripts/verify-readiness.mjs
